correctness.rationale: The host fold has exact exponent \(-\delta^2/(B+\delta)\), and the clock \(t=C/\delta\) advances by \(1+O(t^{-1})\). The exact transverse recurrence has two-step expansion \(v_{n+2}=v_n+(2K/t_n)v_n-v_n^3/3+O(t_n^{-5/2})\) uniformly in the invariant annulus. The resulting squared-amplitude recurrence has inward drift and a contractive squared-error inequality forcing \(w_n\to W_*=3(1+2K)\); signs alternate. Symbolic code verifies critical cancellations and numerical diagnostics check multiple cases but are not the proof.

value.rationale: The original study identifies fold and flip separately, explicitly flagging their simultaneous interaction as unresolved. The derived coefficient changes with coupling \(\beta\) in the original discrete time and quantifies how critical host relaxation changes commensal oscillation amplitude.
